acceptanceCriteria: Reduce scanReceiptNames per-name cost with a before/after benchmark at 13k names, recording load.
Audit error ordering and refusal codes are unchanged, proven by the existing audit tests plus one test pinning the first-error order.
body: Residual from the V1-0887/V1-1403 heartbeat lane (PR #920, branch claude/tasks-heartbeat-o1-0887-1403, head 308b06a1e, base 55b0c0f09; darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores, load 35-39). The two receipts/ listings cost ~1.8 us per name under load (~31 ms at 13k). Validation and hashing are about a third of the per-name cost (<=~10 ms at 13k). Not done in the lane because of the risk to the audit's error ordering.
title: corvint-tasks: cut per-name validation/hash cost in scanReceiptNames (~10 ms at 13k receipts)
